comparison.objective: Dry an upright glass pane with overlapping squeegee strokes; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain blade angle and normal force while translating, wipe between strokes, and return the tool versus hex-bit insertion, bounded torque, fine rotation, relocking, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% of cells cleared, tool returned, fingers clear, and state held one second versus two compliant impacts within travel, force, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both involve force-sensitive tool use, but the record tests continuous surface contact and coverage rather than adjustment and dynamic energy absorption.
